scope: synthetic engineering checks of design defaults (unverified); no calibrated sleep claim
checks: step 1: Q is the clipped product of dial, mood-baseline, threat and stress terms; low mood baseline lowers Q
step 2: weight multiplies arousal, rehearsal, self-relevance and novelty; threat amplifies negative arousal only
step 3: lability is an isolated exponential of delay days
step 4: two thresholds, flat-then-declining age multiplier, monotone reality-testing capacity, logistic noise
gist matching falls back to participant and word overlap; extractive summaries reuse the appraisal gist
encoding writes only a raw buffer entry; buffered memories are retrievable in full with lability retrievability
rehearsal: a buffered recall increments rehearsal_count only; after promotion the existing rule multiplies S and resets the clock
a skip shorter than one sleep opportunity leaves the buffer untouched; an empty buffer gives zero counts
same seed gives identical records (also after a checkpoint round trip); another seed changes only near-threshold entries; sigma 0 is seed-independent
a 50-year skip with a 600-entry buffer resolves once, in about the time of a one-day skip (no per-night loop)
over 1500 seeds: threat sensitivity promotes a high-arousal negative memory more often; low reality testing, old age and near-floor Q lower promotion (insomnia promotes under 30% as often)
config-gated encoding penalty: after near-floor sleep, new memories encode with stability x (1 - strength x (1 - Q))
Lifetime 2-year scripted skip drains the buffer: 12% episodic, 50% gist, 38% dropped; skip-time events follow the same pipeline; dropped and merged entries are never retrieved
the optional LLM summarizer is batched (at most llm_batch_size memories per call), behind the summarizer flag
without a routine, a run split for a checkpoint at any point ends identical to an unbroken run (a controller's closing advance is not a sleep opportunity)
dropped memories never reach the model again: not consolidated, reflected on, shown as earlier questions or recent conversation, and a reminder brings back no feeling
with a household routine sleep resolves at the end of the night (longest off-hours gap, so night shifts work), never mid-afternoon; a long skip is still one resolution
no branch keyed on agent type, role or trait; invalid or inverted settings are rejected
